title: Orunmila verdict log header, schema version 1
description: The verdict log's first line, where its hash chain starts. It names the session, the odù log it judges and the judge that wrote it.
$comment: brief v4 lines 684 (a third hash-chained log), 682 (the swappable judge); Q34, approved by O 2026-11-24 (LD262). The header's shape follows the odù log's (LD167). Unknown fields are allowed (brief v4 line 209).

record.description: Marks this line as the verdict log's header.
record.$comment: agent's choice, as the odù log's header (LD167)

seq.description: The header is the first record of the verdict log; verdicts follow from seq 1.

odu_header.description: The hash of the odù log's header, so the verdict log is tied to the odù log it judged.
odu_header.$comment: brief v4 line 684 (points back to the odù it judged); agent's choice of field, Q34

judge.description: The judge that wrote the log: its name and version. A stricter judge can replace the default one through the same interface.
judge.$comment: brief v4 line 682; agent's choice of field, Q34

name.description: The judge's name: `babalawo` for Orunmila's default judge.
